combat: すき間の大きい水玉３つ
同じ敵には１回だけ当たる
commands.field: 印の留め具を鳴らす
commands.recovery: Base combat cooldown 90 active-play updates. src/magma_powers.c:169 assigns ability_cd/ability_max through game_power_cooldown; src/gear_runtime.c:48 applies equipped-gear recovery. This handler clamps recovery to GAME_MAX_POWER_RECOVERY; cooldown is distinct from startup/effect lifetime. game.c:ability_apply checks magma field actions before all combat dispatch; a compatible active-form field success uses gear-adjusted75. Earlier southern/legacy regional actions may also use gear-adjusted75; northern field actions for13..22 use the selected ability base. No CreatureForm.stats value is used.
